description: Add a skill to the agent - an instruction text that changes how it answers. Returns the created skill with its id. Skills are the right home for behavioural instructions; facts the agent should know belong in FAQs, websites or files instead.

agent_id.description: Optional - attach the skill to one agent.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

description.description: What the skill is for (max 1024 characters).

skill.description: The instruction text the agent follows (max 20000 characters).

title.description: Short name for the skill (max 64 characters).

name: mba_create_agent_skill
title: Create an agent skill
